service.en: Cancel a work permit and employment contract
service.ur: ورک پرمٹ اور ملازمت کا معاہدہ منسوخ کرنا

about: End an employee's work permit and contract when the job finishes.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Employer pays any fines for late issue or non-renewal of permits
Employer gives an official statement that the worker's dues are settled
Employee signs to agree and confirm receiving dues, except when overseas, deceased, ill with a contagious disease or administratively cancelled
documents: Residence visa details if the worker is outside the country or deported
Medical fitness form marked unfit, or a death certificate, in those cases
Both parties sign for e-permits; employer alone for unused initial approvals
fees: Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
Otherwise free on the website and app apart from federal charges
